parameters.name: Namespace
parameters.description:
The name of the namespace.

The name can contain letters, digits, and hyphens (-).

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description:
The page number.

Page numbers start from 1. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of entries per page.

Page numbers start from 1. Default value: 10.

parameters.name: ShowTaskStatistic
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to return the configuration details of metric import tasks for Alibaba Cloud services and the number of metric import tasks for third-party services. Valid values:

*   true
*   false (default)

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cms describe-hybrid-monitor-namespace-list --page-size 10 --page-number 1 --keyword aliyun --namespace aliyun-test --show-task-statistic false --api-version 2019-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cms DescribeHybridMonitorNamespaceList --region cn-hangzhou --PageSize 10 --Keyword aliyun --PageNumber 1 --Namespace 'aliyun-test' --ShowTaskStatistic false
